root_causes: Documentation drift caused the user guide and quick start to describe v1.0.0 after v1.0.1 had been released.
The prior roadmap date and completion claims did not describe the current Park MVP delivery state.
The CPVS retained audit summary previously counted absent raw band rows as failed SNR measurements. The 55-control evidence supports UNKNOWN for missing coverage, not FAIL.

The approved CPVS Master Handoff has inconsistent four-field set arithmetic: it reports F=730239, F\P=55, P\F=0, while also reporting C∩F=730239 and C∩F=P=730184. Actual ID lists and set definitions are required to resolve this conflict.
unresolved: No accepted 5–10 confirmed-source end-to-end API/Workbench/QC/export workflow exists yet.
No 30–50 confirmed-source guided Park demonstration or offline rehearsal is verified.
OID-to-physical-source crosswalk, production QC policy, HMJD/photometric transformations and DR24 feature/inference mapping remain unaccepted.
Scientific performance, calibration, abstention, OOD and anomaly validation remain incomplete.
CPVS exact membership remains a separate scientific blocker.
The handoff's reported Ng>=11 and Nr>=11 diagnostic (730229 candidates / 45 residuals) has not been independently re-run from exact source bytes and hashed ID lists; it remains diagnostic only.
The separately required 1000-object nonmember control sample from all 51418 parent nonmembers, with exact seed, method, ID manifest and hashes, is not verified.
The complete MGPR diagnostic for all required reference, residual and control groups is not verified.
The exact original v0.2.0 production artifact remains unrecovered; ten data/model-dependent integration tests remain skipped until the exact hash-verified inputs are available.

Several older main-targeted PR branches (#244, #246, #247, #252) are divergent from current main by 6–8 commits. Their unique changes must be reconciled with the active PR chains before merge; do not merge stale branches solely because old checks passed.

findings: Bounded HATS retrieval, FastAPI live retrieval and Workbench browser interaction each have source-backed smoke evidence for specific OIDs.
Raw source retention, descriptive QC and JSON export have passed the tested browser assertions.
These tests do not establish physical source identity, production QC, scientific feature compatibility, classifier performance or Park acceptance.
The next decisive product gate is a 5–10 confirmed-source complete workflow with a replayable reproducibility bundle.
The Park MVP is the primary delivery track; CPVS and CIN remain separate workstreams outside its critical path.
The Park readiness percentage is intentionally not stated because no defensible weighted measurement basis exists; gate-level evidence is reported instead.

The submitted Park presentation describes a live demo and a scientific anomaly flag; current evidence supports bounded raw DR24 acquisition and component-level API/Workbench behavior only. The addendum explicitly qualifies these claims.
The 5.32-billion figure is the cited DR24 release scale, not the number of light curves processed by this project.
The original institutional PDFs must remain unchanged; any revised submission must be separately versioned and dated.

A successful scheduled Scientific Validation run on main (42611080798) acquired 150 DR24 source rows, 150 live ALeRCE reference rows, a frozen historical ALeRCE manifest and a StarEmbed source package; these artifacts prove bounded acquisition/provenance, not model performance or Park acceptance.

The 2026-11-09 OOD missingness experiment (PR #280) is diagnostic only: 59 complete paired objects, reconstructed model rather than byte-for-byte production artifact replay, in-sample reference scores, no independent OOD labels.

The approved CPVS Master Handoff provides additional reported diagnostics, but its four-field set arithmetic conflicts and the Ng/Nr threshold test requires source-backed ID manifests and hashes before adoption even as a diagnostic conclusion.
The 150-row DR24 artifact is Objects Table catalog metadata selected lexicographically by OID; it is not 150 raw epoch light curves and is not a representative sample.
The 150-row ALeRCE response is a classifier reference output and is not independent astrophysical ground truth.
The frozen ALeRCE workflow artifact contains only an evidence manifest; it does not contain the three archive payload members.
StarEmbed acquisition pinned revision 33046797fb619f93a991aa4e38a9dc36f27e2d24 and file hashes, but its manifest reports row_count=null and no benchmark model evaluation occurred.
